title: Symbolic Architecture Operator Contracts — Inputs, Thresholds, Outputs and Misuse
purpose: Turn Potatoverse symbolic nouns into usable operators with explicit inputs, transformations, outputs, invariants and misuse tests.
epistemic_rule: These are project-semantic contracts. External threshold, sacred-center and architectural research supplies comparators, not proof that the project topology is universal.

operators.name: House
operators.input: multiple differentiated roles, records or rooms that need stable coexistence
operators.transformation: contain without erasing distinction; preserve ownership and routes
operators.misuse: calling any collection a House when there is no stable interior differentiation

operators.name: Door
operators.input: two distinguishable states/fields plus a permitted transition
operators.transformation: crossing changes status, context, access or responsibility
operators.output: a new state with a legible route back or onward
operators.misuse: mere adjacency; a link is not a Door unless something changes across it

operators.name: Axis
operators.output: comparable position along a common frame
operators.invariant: orientation is stable enough to compare movements

operators.name: Plane
operators.input: actors/objects sharing an ordinary visible interface
operators.transformation: makes lateral relation and encounter possible
operators.invariant: participants remain in the same operative level
operators.misuse: treating every disagreement on the Plane as ascent/descent

operators.name: Root
operators.transformation: stores and feeds continuity beneath visible form
operators.output: support or constraint on later growth
operators.misuse: assuming older automatically means truer or morally better

operators.name: Tree
operators.input: rooted continuity plus pressure to differentiate
operators.invariant: branches remain related to the living trunk/root history
operators.misuse: treating every new branch/page/concept as growth

operators.name: Garden
operators.input: living agents/capacities requiring conditions for growth
operators.transformation: cultivation, protection, pruning, nourishment and space
operators.misuse: calling control or enclosure cultivation merely because it is orderly

operators.name: Mountain
operators.invariant: the summit must remain answerable to the terrain below

operators.name: Swamp
operators.input: unresolved recurrence, mixed provenance, reactive incentives and role-lock
operators.transformation: movement loses footing and becomes increasingly path-dependent
operators.invariant: exit conditions must remain describable if Swamp is to be more than insult
operators.misuse: using Swamp as an essential label for people

operators.name: Forge
operators.input: conflict, contradiction, evidence, residue or pressure
operators.output: tool, clarified model, repair material or weapon
operators.invariant: the output must show what changed under pressure

operators.name: Spiral
operators.transformation: return near a prior position with displacement
operators.misuse: calling a loop a spiral when nothing measurably changes

operators.name: Ring
operators.output: stability, ritual recurrence or stagnation depending context

worked_routes.name: Claim to durable knowledge
worked_routes.route: Root/provenance → Door/evidence threshold → Plane/public statement → Tree/branching implications → Fruit/use
worked_routes.failure_route: weak provenance → repetition → role-lock → Swamp → Ring
worked_routes.lesson: A claim becomes durable by surviving transitions, not by accumulating symbolic names.

worked_routes.name: Conflict to repair
worked_routes.route: World conflict → Roots/history → Forge/contradiction test → Door/repair commitment → Garden/new conditions → Fruit/changed conduct
worked_routes.failure_route: conflict → grievance identity → Tree of Strife → Swamp/Drain
worked_routes.lesson: The same descent into history can feed either repair or recursive conflict.

worked_routes.name: Research branch lifecycle
worked_routes.route: Seed/question → Root/sources → Tree/specialization → Mountain/synthesis → Fruit/public explanation → Seed/new question
worked_routes.pruning_rule: A branch that owns no distinct durable function should merge back into a stronger owner.

external_comparators.finding: Architecture and ritual research treats thresholds as controlled boundaries and transition zones. Viking Age archaeology documents doors/portals as connections between living and dead, controllable boundaries and liminal between-spaces.
external_comparators.project_value: Supports Door as transition rather than mere adjacency.
external_comparators.boundary: Not every doorway is a ritual transition and the project Door remains its own modern operator.

external_comparators.finding: Pueblo architecture provides an example in which an earth navel joins lower, middle and upper worlds while multiple surrounding directional centers coexist. Angkor Wat deliberately architecturalizes Mount Meru and cosmic order.
external_comparators.project_value: Shows that sacred-center/axis architecture can be materially organized in very different cultural systems.
external_comparators.boundary: Axis mundi is a comparative category, not evidence that these traditions share one hidden map.

quality_tests: Can the operator be expressed as a change, not merely a noun?
What output demonstrates that the operator did real work?
What common misuse collapses it into another operator?
